hypothesis: Two independently decaying rank-4 online causal factorizations, using a combined 256 float32 per-world persistent state, can balance rapid changes and stable mechanism memory more effectively than equally sized full-rank 16x16 predictor, without exceeding 3x end-to-end CPU latency.

source.construction: Use pinned P86's pure SHA256-indexed integer and exact dyadic 16D action and rank4 16D consequence generation; 48 confirmed executed action/effect pairs and novel withheld-effect action49. Hidden second independent causal map after action24 in exactly half worlds. No prior P86-P91 FIT/VAL reuse. Do not create protected OOD/NEGATIVE.
source.audit: FIT+VAL source hashes byte-identical across Windows/Linux; all finite, source half changed; final query new key no repeated cosine abs>=.999; effect of final query never enters model.

methods.fixed: P86 CAL-locked W256 eta1 decay.99, 0 trained params.
methods.full_grid: FIT-only eta {.5,1,1.5} × decay {.95,.99} =6 full 16x16 W256 conventional rules. Choose one globally by A+B FIT combined final-query MSE, freeze before VAL.
methods.dual_grid: FIT-only eta_fast {.5,1} × decay_fast {.90,.97} × eta_slow {.10,.25}, decay_slow .99 =8. Each fast and slow slot factor U[16,4] V[4,16] = 128 floats; two slots total 256 float32 predictive floats. Read (Ufast@Vfast+Uslow@Vslow)@normalize(action), then upon actually observed event form each slot W_candidate=decay_slot*(U@V)+eta_slot*(effect-read)*key.T; project via batched torch.linalg.svd to rank4 and store U_top4*sqrt(S4) / sqrt(S4)*Vh_top4. SVD temporary matrix memory included in CPU cost.
methods.single_rank4_ablation: Evaluate selected dual's fast slot alone using 128 floats, disclose capacity mismatch and no VAL tuning.

protocol.wrong_credit: Cyclic rotation within-world observed historical effects must cause >=1.5x conventional fixed VAL final MSE and >=.01 absolute on each family.
protocol.cold: Checkpoint factor tensors after 24 observed events, resume and compare bitwise final states and predicted query; no extra persistent state.
protocol.qualify: Dual must beat stronger of frozen fixed and FIT-selected W256 full model by >=10% each family's combined final MSE, >=15% each changed-world MSE, stable <=5% worse each; dual must beat single-rank4 ablation by >=10% on both families. Any miss => DEV_FAIL; no OOD/NEG generation.
protocol.cost: Run 5 warmups and 20 timed loops on identical VAL inputs, full 49-read/48-update forward CPU thread1. Dual must be <=3x median wall of full W256 comparator. Transient SVD workspace uncounted in persistent 256 floats but cost disclosed. Failure cost => DEV_FAIL.
protocol.science: Author-synthetic DEV comparison only; no fully trained original HybridPilot, no inference transfer, external causal intervention first-use, matched whole-process compute, RSI or SCIENTIFIC_PASS; no threshold retuning after results.
